source_policy: Primary references support definitions and stated conditions. Scenarios and worked derivations are originally authored constructions. The supplied book matrix guides sequencing; it is not independent verification of exact-edition book coverage.
purpose: See why averaging more independent parcel masses narrows the distribution of the mean while its center stays fixed.
meaning: A sampling distribution assigns probabilities to a statistic across repeated samples under an explicit sampling rule. Here every independent ordered sample with replacement is enumerated, and identical sample means are grouped by exact multiplicities.

definition.setting: Draw independently with replacement from four equally likely parcel masses 2, 4, 8 and 10 kg. Enumerate every ordered sample, rather than drawing an animated random sample.
definition.formal_latex: X_i\in\{2,4,8,10\},\quad P(X_i=x)=\tfrac14.\quad\bar X=\frac1n\sum_{i=1}^{n}X_i,\quad E[\bar X]=6,\quad\operatorname{Var}(\bar X)=\frac{10}{n},\quad \operatorname{SE}(\bar X)=\sqrt{10/n}.

signature.SE(X̄): Standard deviation of the sample mean, in kg.

conditions: Draw independently with replacement from four equally likely parcel masses 2, 4, 8 and 10 kg. Enumerate every ordered sample, rather than drawing an animated random sample.
Sample size is a whole number from 1 to 4. The complete finite sampling distribution is exact; its standard error is evaluated numerically. Sampling without replacement has a different variance.
